words.definitionEn: to formally end a law, custom or system so that it no longer exists
words.situation: An authority decides that a rule, fee, institution or tradition will officially stop existing.

examples.text: The city [[abolished]] bus fares last year, and now everyone travels for free.
Our company has [[abolished]] fixed working hours, so staff can start and finish whenever they like.
Reformers campaigned for decades to [[abolish]] the practice of sending young children to work in factories.

texts: Many people would love to [[abolish]] the annual switch to summer time.
The university plans to [[abolish]] entrance exams and select students by interview instead.
If you could [[abolish]] one rule in this office, which would it be?

badCollocation.noteRu: Решение суда или начальства не abolish, а overturn или reverse. Abolish — упразднить закон, налог или систему целиком.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Монархию, налоги и законы упраздняют глаголом abolish. Cancel — про встречи и заказы, resign — уйти в отставку, delete — удалить файл.

nuance.text: The council voted to [[abolish]] parking charges in the town centre.
nuance.explanationRu: Abolish — официально упразднить сбор, правило или систему. Demolish — снести здание; парковочные сборы снести нельзя.

reverse.text: The old cinema was [[demolished]] to make room for new flats.
reverse.explanationRu: Здания сносят — demolish. Abolish относится к законам, налогам и обычаям, а не к постройкам.

fixIt.text: The reform [[liquidated]] three ministries and merged their work into a single department.
fixIt.explanationRu: Liquidate по-английски — ликвидировать фирму через продажу её активов. Министерства и должности упраздняют — abolish.

wordFormation.text: The [[abolition]] of roaming charges made calling home from abroad much cheaper.

reply.context: A colleague messages you: "Big news: management wants to scrap the dress code completely."
options: Kindly be advised that I concur with the abolition of said code.
About time! Nobody follows it anyway, so they might as well abolish it.
Great, maybe they'll abolish my old laptop too, it's so slow.
reply.explanationRu: Abolish подходит к правилам и системам, а не к вещам вроде ноутбука. Первый вариант звучит как канцелярское письмо, а не ответ коллеге в чате.

words.definitionEn: the fact that something is lacking or does not exist
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «отсутствие чего-либо» (absence of evidence); значение «неявка на работу или в школу» не тренируется.
words.situation: You notice that something expected, such as proof, interest or a clear rule, simply is not there.

examples.text: In the [[absence]] of any clear evidence, the court had no choice but to release him.
What worried investors most was the complete [[absence]] of a long-term plan.
Dinner with his parents was polite enough, but there was a striking [[absence]] of warmth.

texts: The [[absence]] of street lights makes this road dangerous at night.
Doctors were puzzled by the [[absence]] of any obvious symptoms.
Silence is not simply the [[absence]] of noise; it can feel full of meaning.

badCollocation.noteRu: О нехватке времени или денег говорят lack of time или no time. Absence звучит книжно и подходит к доказательствам, объяснениям, правилам.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Идиома conspicuous by its absence — «бросается в глаза своим отсутствием». Lack, shortage и loss в эту фразу не входят.

nuance.text: In the [[absence]] of clear instructions, the team decided to wait.
nuance.explanationRu: In the absence of — устойчивая модель «при отсутствии». С lack так не говорят: нужно for lack of или without.

reverse.text: She was exhausted from [[lack]] of sleep after the night shift.
reverse.explanationRu: Нехватку сна, денег, времени обозначают словом lack. Absence of sleep звучит неестественно: absence — полное отсутствие, а не нехватка.

fixIt.text: The [[deficit]] of any explanation from the airline made passengers even angrier.
fixIt.explanationRu: Deficit — дефицит бюджета или торговли. Когда чего-то просто нет (объяснений, доказательств), говорят absence.

wordFormation.text: The [[absence]] of a clear timetable made planning the trip almost impossible.

reply.context: In a meeting, your manager asks: "Why do you think the project stalled last spring?"
options: Honestly, a total absence of time — everyone was far too busy.
Be advised that the absence of leadership is hereby cited as the primary cause.
Mostly the absence of a clear leader: nobody felt able to make decisions.
reply.explanationRu: Absence — полное отсутствие (лидера, плана); о нехватке времени говорят lack of time. Второй ответ звучит как казённый документ, а не живой разговор.

rewrite.original: Because there was no reliable data, the team had to guess.
rewrite.frame: In ____ reliable data, the team had to guess.
rewrite.explanationRu: Устойчивое выражение: in the absence of — «при отсутствии».

words.definitionEn: not present or not found in a place, situation or thing
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «отсутствует там, где его ожидаешь» (humour is absent from the film); «не пришёл на урок или работу» не тренируется.
words.situation: You point out that a quality, feature or element you expected cannot be found anywhere in something.

examples.text: In the sequel, the sharp humour of her first novel is almost entirely [[absent]], and the jokes feel forced.
Large predators are now [[absent]] across much of the region, so deer numbers have soared.
She read out the results in a flat, calm voice; any hint of emotion was completely [[absent]].

texts: Vitamin D is naturally [[absent]] from most everyday foods.
Women were largely [[absent]] from the history books we studied at school.
In his letters, any warmth towards his brother is strangely [[absent]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Конструкции absent of нет. Говорят humour is absent from the film или the film is devoid of humour.

collocationTask.explanationRu: После absent нужен предлог from: absent from the discussion. Предлоги of, to и by с этим прилагательным не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Humour is completely [[absent]] from his latest novel.
nuance.explanationRu: Absent from — «отсутствует в чём-то» (юмор в книге, факты в отчёте). Away говорят только о людях, которые уехали или не на месте.

reverse.text: Sorry, my manager is [[away]] until Monday — can I take a message?
reverse.explanationRu: О коллеге в отпуске или командировке говорят away. Absent в такой фразе звучит как отметка о прогуле в журнале.

fixIt.text: Clear instructions were completely [[absence]] from the manual that came with the printer.
fixIt.explanationRu: После were нужно прилагательное: absent from — «отсутствует». Absence — существительное «отсутствие».

wordFormation.text: She stirred her coffee [[absently]], her mind clearly somewhere else.

rewrite.original: The new model has none of the features that made the old one popular.
rewrite.frame: The features that made the old model popular ____ from the new one.
rewrite.explanationRu: Absent from — «отсутствуют в чём-то»; перед прилагательным нужен глагол are.

words.definitionEn: completely unreasonable or ridiculous, making no sense at all
words.situation: You react to an idea, rule, price or claim that seems ridiculous and completely unreasonable.

examples.text: Asking the team to finish a six-month project in two weeks is simply [[absurd]].
Twelve euros for a coffee? That's an [[absurd]] price, even for an airport.
The play's plot is deliberately [[absurd]]: a man wakes up to find he has turned into a chair.

texts: It seems [[absurd]] to pay rent for a flat we never use.
The rumour that the boss sleeps in his office is clearly [[absurd]].
Looking back, our whole argument about the parking space was [[absurd]].

badCollocation.noteRu: Absurd — уже сильное слово, поэтому его усиливают словами completely, utterly или simply, а не very.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Absurd усиливают наречиями utterly, completely, patently. Strongly, greatly и heavily с этим прилагательным не сочетаются.

nuance.text: Charging customers for a glass of tap water is [[absurd]].
nuance.explanationRu: Absurd — нелепый, лишённый логики (правило, цена, требование). Surreal — странный, как во сне; о плате за воду так не говорят.

reverse.text: Meeting my childhood hero in a supermarket queue felt completely [[surreal]].
reverse.explanationRu: Surreal — «как во сне, нереально». Absurd значило бы «нелепо, глупо», а встреча с кумиром скорее невероятна, чем глупа.

fixIt.text: The situation became so [[anecdotal]] that even the manager started laughing.
fixIt.explanationRu: Anecdotal значит «основанный на отдельных историях» (anecdotal evidence). Нелепая, смехотворная ситуация — absurd.

wordFormation.text: Everyone could see the [[absurdity]] of holding a meeting to plan another meeting.

reply.context: A colleague sighs: "They want the full report by tomorrow morning, and we only got the data an hour ago."
options: How absurd! I'm really looking forward to reading it.
One must pronounce such a request absurd in the extreme, madam.
That's absurd — nobody could write it properly in one evening.
reply.explanationRu: Absurd — «нелепо, так не бывает», это возмущение, а не радость. Вариант с madam звучит театрально и не подходит для разговора с коллегой.

words.definitionEn: a very large amount of something, often more than enough
words.situation: You describe a place, season or source where there is much more of something than people need.

examples.text: Locals love the island for its [[abundance]] of fresh fish and seafood.
Wild mushrooms grow here in [[abundance]] every autumn, so bring a big basket.
In a world of information [[abundance]], the real challenge is deciding what to ignore.

texts: This year's [[abundance]] of tomatoes meant we gave half of them away.
Despite the [[abundance]] of cheap flights, many people still prefer the train.
The city is famous for its [[abundance]] of parks and green spaces.

badCollocation.noteRu: О толпе не говорят abundance of people — скажите crowds of people или a lot of people. Abundance — об изобилии ресурсов, еды, возможностей.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Устойчивое выражение in abundance — «в изобилии». Majority, amount и richness в эту модель не встают.

nuance.text: Children growing up in the countryside enjoy an [[abundance]] of fresh air and space.
nuance.explanationRu: Abundance — изобилие чего-то хорошего и нужного. Excess — излишек, «слишком много», это звучит как проблема, а свежий воздух проблемой не бывает.

reverse.text: The doctor warned him that an [[excess]] of salt was raising his blood pressure.
reverse.explanationRu: Когда чего-то слишком много и это вредно (соль, сахар), говорят excess. Abundance звучит положительно.

fixIt.text: The rainforest is famous for its [[affluence]] of plant and insect species.
fixIt.explanationRu: Affluence — достаток, богатство людей (affluent families). Изобилие видов, ресурсов, еды — abundance.

wordFormation.text: Tourists are drawn by the [[abundance]] of cheap, delicious street food.

rewrite.original: Wild strawberries grow everywhere in this forest, in huge numbers.
rewrite.frame: Wild strawberries grow ____ in this forest.
rewrite.explanationRu: In abundance — «в изобилии», устойчивое выражение без артикля.

words.definitionEn: the wrong or harmful use of something, such as power, drugs or trust
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «злоупотребление» (abuse of power, drug abuse); значения «жестокое обращение» и «оскорбления» не тренируются.
words.situation: Someone uses their position, a privilege, a substance or a system in a harmful or dishonest way.

examples.text: The accountant who secretly moved clients' savings into her own account committed a gross [[abuse]] of trust.
Years of alcohol [[abuse]] had seriously damaged his liver.
Free trials are limited to one per customer to prevent [[abuse]] of the system.

texts: The charity runs programmes to prevent drug [[abuse]] in schools.
Critics warned that the new benefit system was wide open to [[abuse]].
Strict rules on expense claims are meant to stop [[abuse]] by a few employees.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Злоупотреблять сладким» — eat too many sweets или overdo the sweets. Abuse звучит как серьёзная зависимость или преступное злоупотребление.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Злоупотребление властью — an abuse of power. Excess — «избыток», overdose — «передозировка», insult — «оскорбление»; с power так не говорят.

nuance.text: Using public money to redecorate his own home was a clear [[abuse]] of his position.
nuance.explanationRu: Abuse of position или power — использовать должность или власть ради личной выгоды. Violation — нарушение правил или прав; «нарушить должность» нельзя.

reverse.text: Filming people without their consent is a [[violation]] of privacy.
reverse.explanationRu: Нарушение права или правила — violation of privacy или of the rules. С privacy слово abuse не сочетается: его берут с power, trust, position.

fixIt.text: The mayor was accused of an [[overuse]] of power after giving city jobs to his relatives.
fixIt.explanationRu: Злоупотребление властью — abuse of power. Overuse — «слишком частое использование» (overuse of antibiotics), а не корыстное.

wordFormation.text: Regulators fined the bank for [[abusive]] lending practices that trapped customers in debt.

reply.context: In a team chat, someone asks: "Should we let everyone use the company card for taxis?"
options: Only with receipts — otherwise the system is open to abuse.
Sure, and let's abuse the drivers with huge tips.
Verily, such generosity doth invite abuse most grievous.
reply.explanationRu: Open to abuse — «открыт для злоупотреблений». Abuse the drivers значит «оскорблять водителей», а третий ответ звучит как пьеса Шекспира.

words.definitionEn: an official society of distinguished scientists, scholars or artists that promotes their field
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «академия как объединение учёных или деятелей искусства» (academy of sciences); значение «специальное училище» (police academy) не тренируется.
words.situation: You talk about the official body that elects top scientists or artists as members and honours their work.

examples.text: At forty-two, she became the youngest scientist ever elected to the national [[academy]].
Every summer the [[academy]] invites its members to exhibit their latest paintings and sculptures.
The language [[academy]] has officially accepted several new words borrowed from English.

texts: Only a handful of women were elected to the [[academy]] in its first century.
The [[academy]] publishes an official dictionary every few decades.
His paintings were rejected by the [[academy]], so he organised his own exhibition.

badCollocation.noteRu: Академия наук — сообщество учёных: в неё избирают (be elected to), а не оканчивают её, как вуз.

collocationTask.explanationRu: В академию как сообщество учёных избирают — be elected to the academy. Enrolled — о студентах, hired — о сотрудниках, graduated — об окончании вуза.

nuance.text: Last year the [[academy]] elected twelve new members, including two physicists.
nuance.explanationRu: Academy — конкретная организация с членами и выборами. Academia — весь мир университетов и науки в целом; он никого не избирает.

reverse.text: After ten years in [[academia]], she moved into industry.
reverse.explanationRu: Academia — академическая среда, мир вузов и исследований. Academy — конкретная организация, и in academy так не говорят.

fixIt.text: The national [[academic]] of sciences has awarded her its highest medal.
fixIt.explanationRu: Academic — учёный или прилагательное «академический». Организация, в которую избирают учёных, — academy.

reply.context: A colleague mentions: "My old professor has just been elected to the academy of sciences."
options: That's a huge honour — the academy only elects a few people each year.
Great! Will she be taking classes at the academy from September?
Kindly convey my most profound felicitations upon her elevation to the academy.
reply.explanationRu: В академию наук избирают за научные заслуги, там не ходят на занятия. Третий вариант звучит слишком торжественно для разговора с коллегой.

words.definitionEn: to make a process or change happen faster or sooner
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «ускорять процесс, развитие»; значение «набирать скорость (о машине)» не тренируется.
words.situation: A change, trend or project starts moving faster, often because of a new policy, event or technology.

examples.text: The pandemic [[accelerated]] the shift to online shopping, squeezing ten years of change into one.
Hiring two more developers should [[accelerate]] the project and help us meet the deadline.
Reading widely is one of the best ways of [[accelerating]] your progress in a new language.

texts: Rising temperatures [[accelerate]] the melting of mountain glaciers.
New software tools can [[accelerate]] the design process dramatically.
Some parents try to [[accelerate]] their children's learning with extra classes.

badCollocation.noteRu: Встречу на более раннее время переносят — bring forward или move up. Accelerate — ускорить процесс или рост, а не сдвинуть дату.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Рост экономики ускоряют — accelerate economic growth. Hurry, hustle и race — о спешке людей, с экономическим ростом они не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The government wants to [[accelerate]] the switch to electric buses.
nuance.explanationRu: Accelerate — ускорить процесс, рост, переход. Hurry — «спешить, торопиться» о людях; hurry the switch звучит неестественно.

reverse.text: Please [[hurry]] — the taxi is already waiting outside.
reverse.explanationRu: Человеку, который опаздывает, говорят hurry. Accelerate — о процессах и машинах, а не о сборах к такси.

fixIt.text: Working with a good mentor can [[fasten]] your career development more than any online course.
fixIt.explanationRu: Fasten — «застегнуть, пристегнуть» (fasten your seatbelt). Ускорить развитие или процесс — accelerate.

wordFormation.text: The sudden [[acceleration]] of inflation took many economists by surprise.

reply.context: In a meeting, your manager asks: "How can we get the new app to market sooner?"
options: We could accelerate testing by bringing in an outside team.
We could accelerate the budget by cutting a few costs.
Just floor it, mate, and chuck the thing out already.
reply.explanationRu: Accelerate сочетается с процессами (testing, growth), а «ускорить бюджет» бессмысленно. Третий ответ слишком грубый и разговорный для совещания.

rewrite.original: The new policy made the move to renewable energy happen faster.
rewrite.frame: The new policy ____ the move to renewable energy.
rewrite.explanationRu: Make something happen faster — то же, что accelerate something: «ускорить».

words.definitionEn: the general agreement that an idea, product or person is suitable or welcome
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «признание, одобрение обществом» (gain acceptance); значение «согласие принять предложение или приглашение» не тренируется.
words.situation: Over time, more and more people come to see a new idea, product or group as normal and welcome.

examples.text: It took decades for the theory of continental drift to gain wide [[acceptance]] among scientists.
For many immigrants, learning the language is the first step towards [[acceptance]] in their new community.
Remote work, once seen as a risky experiment, now enjoys broad [[acceptance]] among employers.

texts: Public [[acceptance]] of self-driving cars is still surprisingly low.
Her poetry finally found [[acceptance]] after years of rejection by critics.
The campaign aims to promote [[acceptance]] of people with different body shapes.

badCollocation.noteRu: Признание заслуг и таланта — recognition. Acceptance — готовность считать что-то нормальным или правильным.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Признание завоёвывают: gain или win acceptance. Make, do и take с acceptance не сочетаются.

nuance.text: It took years for online banking to win general [[acceptance]] among older customers.
nuance.explanationRu: Acceptance — люди начинают считать что-то нормальным и пользоваться этим. Recognition — признание заслуг; к онлайн-банку у пожилых клиентов это не подходит.

reverse.text: She received international [[recognition]] for her work on malaria.
reverse.explanationRu: Признание заслуг учёного — recognition. Acceptance значит «одобрение, готовность принять», за работу его не получают.

fixIt.text: The idea of a four-day week is slowly gaining [[admission]] among employers.
fixIt.explanationRu: Admission — «признание вины» или «приём, вход». Когда идею постепенно начинают одобрять, говорят gain acceptance.

wordFormation.text: The film explores a teenager's struggle for [[acceptance]] at a new school.

reply.context: At a debate club, someone asks: "Do you think electric cars will ever replace petrol ones?"
options: Probably, but most drivers haven't sent their acceptance yet.
Probably. They've already gained wide acceptance in several countries.
Totes, they're like sooo accepted now, no cap.
reply.explanationRu: Gain acceptance — «получить признание, стать привычным». Send acceptance — ответ на приглашение, здесь не к месту. Третий вариант — сленг, для дебатов не годится.

words.definitionEn: easy for people without special knowledge to understand or enjoy
words.senseNote: Выбрано значение «понятный, доступный для понимания» (an accessible book); значение «такой, куда можно попасть» не тренируется.
words.situation: A book, talk, artwork or explanation is made so that people without special training can follow it.

examples.text: Her brilliant book makes quantum physics [[accessible]] to readers with no scientific background.
The museum keeps its exhibitions [[accessible]] by avoiding long academic texts on the walls.
I know you don't like jazz, but this album is really [[accessible]], so give it a try.

texts: The lecturer has a gift for making complex ideas [[accessible]].
Written in plain language, the report is [[accessible]] to any interested reader.
Opera can be surprisingly [[accessible]] if you start with the popular classics.

badCollocation.noteRu: Доступная цена — affordable price. Accessible — «понятный» или «такой, куда можно попасть», но не «недорогой».

collocationTask.explanationRu: Понятное, доходчивое введение — an accessible introduction. Available — «имеющийся в наличии», achievable — «достижимый», admissible — «допустимый».

nuance.text: The textbook explains statistics in a clear, [[accessible]] way.
nuance.explanationRu: Accessible — понятный без специальной подготовки. Available — «есть в наличии, можно получить»; манера объяснения не бывает available.

reverse.text: Tickets for the festival are [[available]] online from Monday.
reverse.explanationRu: О билетах и товарах, которые можно купить, говорят available. Accessible означало бы «понятные» или «куда можно пройти».

fixIt.text: Good popular science books make difficult ideas [[reachable]] to ordinary readers.
fixIt.explanationRu: Reachable — «до чего можно добраться или дозвониться». Идеи, понятные обычному читателю, — accessible.

wordFormation.text: Critics praised the [[accessibility]] of her writing, which never talks down to readers.

reply.context: A friend texts: "Can you recommend a book about economics? I'm a total beginner."
options: I would humbly submit that this volume is eminently accessible to the uninitiated.
Try this one — it's very accessible, only five pounds in most shops.
Try this one — it's really accessible and there's hardly any maths.
reply.explanationRu: Accessible — «понятный новичку». О низкой цене говорят affordable или cheap. Первый ответ звучит слишком книжно для переписки с другом.

words.definitionEn: the period following a disaster, war or crisis, and the effects it leaves
words.situation: Describing the difficult period that follows a war, disaster or scandal, when people deal with the damage.

examples.text: Thousands of volunteers helped to clear the streets in the [[aftermath]] of the hurricane.
We spent Sunday morning cleaning up the [[aftermath]] of Saturday's birthday party.
The novel follows three families through the chaotic [[aftermath]] of the revolution, when food and work were scarce.

texts: Food prices rose sharply in the [[aftermath]] of the drought.
Counsellors visited the school to support pupils in the [[aftermath]] of the fire.
The coach refused to speak to reporters in the immediate [[aftermath]] of the defeat.

badCollocation.noteRu: Aftermath — всегда о тяжёлом периоде после беды. О хороших результатах говорят positive effects или benefits.

collocationTask.explanationRu: In the aftermath of — «после бедствия, когда разбираются с его последствиями». Result, outcome и effect в такой рамке не используют: говорят as a result of.

nuance.text: Many shops stayed closed for weeks in the [[aftermath]] of the floods.
nuance.explanationRu: Aftermath — период после беды и обстановка в это время. Consequence — отдельное последствие; оборота in the consequence of нет, говорят as a consequence of.

reverse.text: Higher bus fares are a direct [[consequence]] of the new fuel tax.
reverse.explanationRu: Конкретный результат решения — a consequence. Aftermath — не отдельное следствие, а тяжёлый период после события.

fixIt.text: Hundreds of families were left homeless in the [[result]] of the flood.
fixIt.explanationRu: In the result of — калька с «в результате». О периоде после бедствия говорят in the aftermath of, а о причине — as a result of.

reply.context: A colleague messages you: "How's the office after last week's big move?"
options: Brilliant! The aftermath was a lovely surprise party for the whole team.
Still a bit chaotic. We're dealing with the aftermath: boxes everywhere and no Wi-Fi yet.
The aftermath of the relocation is hereby being processed by the relevant personnel.
reply.explanationRu: Aftermath — неприятные последствия события, к празднику это слово не подходит. Третий вариант звучит как казённый отчёт, а не ответ коллеге.

rewrite.original: The town struggled for years after the factory closed down.
rewrite.frame: The town struggled for years in ____ of the factory closure.
rewrite.explanationRu: In the aftermath of — «после тяжёлого события и в его последствиях».

words.definitionEn: angry, hostile behaviour or feelings that may lead to attacking others
words.situation: Describing hostile, threatening behaviour in people or animals, such as shouting, pushing or trying to attack.

examples.text: Male deer show more [[aggression]] in the mating season, so photographers keep their distance.
The manager's constant [[aggression]] in meetings made junior staff afraid to share ideas.
Researchers tested whether violent video games make teenagers more prone to [[aggression]].

texts: Shouting at children can teach them [[aggression]] instead of respect.
Boxing helps him channel his [[aggression]] into something useful.
The treaty was meant to prevent further [[aggression]] between the two states.

badCollocation.noteRu: О своём настроении так не говорят. Скажите I feel angry или I'm really irritable today.

collocationTask.explanationRu: An act of aggression — устойчивое сочетание: враждебный, агрессивный шаг. Attack и fight уже сами обозначают действие, поэтому act of с ними не говорят.

nuance.text: Her emails were polite, but you could sense the hidden [[aggression]] in every line.
nuance.explanationRu: Aggression — враждебный настрой, который может звучать и в словах, и в тоне. Violence — физическое насилие, в вежливом письме его быть не может.

reverse.text: The film is not suitable for children because of its graphic [[violence]].
reverse.explanationRu: Сцены насилия в кино — graphic violence. Aggression — враждебное поведение или настрой, а не показанное на экране насилие.

fixIt.text: Some dogs show [[violence]] towards strangers when they feel threatened.
fixIt.explanationRu: О враждебном поведении животных говорят show aggression. Violence — физическое насилие, show violence в этом смысле не говорят.

wordFormation.text: Witnesses disagreed about which driver had been the [[aggressor]] in the roadside argument.

reply.context: A friend tells you: "My neighbour's dog growls and shows its teeth every time I walk past."
options: How sweet! It must feel a lot of aggression for you already.
One is advised to report such canine aggression to the relevant authority forthwith.
That sounds like real aggression. Maybe mention it to the owner before someone gets bitten.
reply.explanationRu: Aggression — враждебность, а не нежность, поэтому первый ответ не подходит. Второй звучит как официальное предписание, а не ответ другу.

words.definitionEn: pleasant and enjoyable, or friendly and easy to like
words.senseNote: Здесь — «приятный»; значение «согласный на что-то» (if you are agreeable) встречается реже.
words.situation: Describing a pleasant evening, place or person that is easy to enjoy and causes no trouble.

examples.text: We spent a truly [[agreeable]] evening on the terrace, chatting, laughing and watching the sunset.
My new flatmate is very [[agreeable]]: easy-going, tidy and always ready to help.
The climate on the coast is [[agreeable]] all year, never too hot or too cold.

texts: The weather stayed [[agreeable]] for the whole of our holiday.
She found her new colleagues [[agreeable]] and easy to work with.
The soup had a rich, [[agreeable]] flavour of roasted peppers.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Я с вами согласен» — I agree with you. Agreeable значит «приятный», и I'm agreeable with you звучит странно.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Agreeable описывает и людей, и события: an agreeable surprise. Amiable, affable и obliging говорят только о людях — о приветливом и услужливом характере.

nuance.text: The spa has a calm, [[agreeable]] atmosphere and a lovely view of the lake.
nuance.explanationRu: Agreeable описывает и людей, и обстановку, погоду, вкус. Likeable — только о людях или героях, которые вызывают симпатию; likeable atmosphere не говорят.

fixIt.text: The hotel stood on a quiet, [[sympathetic]] square full of cafés and flower stalls.
fixIt.explanationRu: Sympathetic — «сочувствующий», а не «симпатичный». Приятное, уютное место описывают словом agreeable.

wordFormation.text: Despite the rain, the walk along the cliffs turned out to be surprisingly [[agreeable]].

words.definitionEn: connected with farming, growing crops or raising animals
words.situation: Describing land, machinery, jobs or policies that have to do with growing crops and keeping animals.

examples.text: Much of the forest was cleared to create new [[agricultural]] land for cattle and soya.
The region's economy is mainly [[agricultural]], with most families growing olives or grapes.
Students of [[agricultural]] science learn how soil, water and weather affect crops.

texts: Heavy rain destroyed large areas of [[agricultural]] land this spring.
Tractors and other [[agricultural]] machinery are expensive to repair.
The country exports mostly [[agricultural]] products such as wheat and sugar.

badCollocation.noteRu: Agricultural — прилагательное. «Работать в сельском хозяйстве» — work in agriculture или work on a farm.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Техника для полей — agricultural machinery. Rural, country и village описывают сельскую местность и жизнь, а не технику.

nuance.text: Rising fuel prices have hit [[agricultural]] exports such as grain and sunflower oil.
nuance.explanationRu: Agricultural — связанный с сельским хозяйством: продукция, техника, земля. Rural — связанный с сельской местностью (rural areas, rural life); rural exports не говорят.

reverse.text: Buses in [[rural]] Scotland can run as rarely as twice a day.
reverse.explanationRu: Rural Scotland — сельская глубинка Шотландии. Agricultural относится к фермерству, а не к местности.

fixIt.text: The factory produces tractors and other [[rural]] machinery for export.
fixIt.explanationRu: Rural — «сельский» о местности и жизни. Техника для полей — agricultural machinery.

wordFormation.text: Nearly half of the country's [[agricultural]] output comes from small family farms.

words.definitionEn: a person who assists a senior official or politician in their work
words.situation: Talking about the assistants who work closely with a president, minister or other senior official.

examples.text: The president arrived with two [[aides]] who carried his papers and managed his schedule.
A former [[aide]] has written a revealing book about life inside the mayor's office.
Her grandmother has a home-care [[aide]] who visits every morning to help her wash and dress.

texts: The senator's [[aides]] worked through the night to finish the speech.
Two presidential [[aides]] were questioned about the missing documents.
Nursing [[aides]] help patients eat, wash and move around the ward.

badCollocation.noteRu: Aide — человек-помощник. Помощь как ресурс — aid: humanitarian aid, first aid.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Помощника политика называют aide. Aid — это помощь, а не человек; helper и worker звучат слишком просто для такой должности.

nuance.text: A former [[aide]] to the governor has agreed to give evidence in court.
nuance.explanationRu: Aide — человек, помощник чиновника или политика. Aid — помощь (деньги, еда, лекарства), человеком быть не может.

reverse.text: The charity sends medical [[aid]] to areas hit by floods.
reverse.explanationRu: Медицинская или гуманитарная помощь — aid. Aide — человек-помощник, а не ресурс.

fixIt.text: A senior [[helper]] to the mayor was dismissed for leaking confidential documents.
fixIt.explanationRu: Helper — просто «тот, кто помогает». Помощник мэра или министра — aide.

words.definitionEn: used to add a fact that limits what was just said; although
words.situation: Adding a small contrast or limitation to a statement, usually in formal writing, before an adjective or short phrase.

examples.text: The project was a success, [[albeit]] a rather expensive one.
The economy is growing again, [[albeit]] more slowly than the government had hoped.
After a long discussion, my father agreed to lend us the car, [[albeit]] rather reluctantly.

texts: The hotel was comfortable, [[albeit]] a little far from the beach.
He apologised, [[albeit]] only after his manager insisted.
The band's new album is enjoyable, [[albeit]] less original than their first.

badCollocation.noteRu: После albeit обычно не ставят целое предложение с подлежащим: albeit slowly, albeit small. С полным предложением — although: although it was raining.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Albeit ставят перед наречием или короткой фразой: albeit briefly. После despite нужно существительное, а после whereas и because — целое предложение.

nuance.text: The team finished third, [[albeit]] with a much smaller budget than its rivals.
nuance.explanationRu: Albeit вводит уступку перед фразой: albeit with a smaller budget. Despite — предлог, после него сразу существительное (despite a smaller budget), с with он не сочетается.

reverse.text: The match went ahead [[despite]] the heavy rain.
reverse.explanationRu: Перед существительным нужен предлог despite. Albeit не работает как предлог: albeit the heavy rain — ошибка.

fixIt.text: The new policy is a step forward, [[despite]] a small one.
fixIt.explanationRu: Despite значит «несмотря на» и здесь бессмысленно. Чтобы добавить оговорку «хоть и небольшой», нужно albeit a small one.

reply.context: Your manager asks in a meeting: "So, did the new booking system work over the weekend?"
options: It did, albeit with a few delays on Saturday morning.
It did, albeit it crashed and we lost every single booking.
Albeit, like, it kinda worked, I guess?
reply.explanationRu: Albeit добавляет небольшую оговорку перед фразой. Во втором ответе «оговорка» перечёркивает весь смысл, а в третьем albeit стоит не к месту в небрежной разговорной фразе.

rewrite.original: Sales rose last month, although the rise was very small.
rewrite.frame: Sales rose last month, ____ slightly.
rewrite.explanationRu: Albeit + наречие: albeit slightly — «хоть и незначительно».

words.definitionEn: quick to notice things and ready to react, especially to danger
words.senseNote: Прилагательное «бдительный, собранный»; существительное alert (сигнал тревоги) здесь не тренируем.
words.situation: Describing someone who is wide awake, watching carefully and ready to notice danger or react quickly.

examples.text: Long-distance drivers should take regular breaks to stay [[alert]] at the wheel.
Although he is ninety, my grandfather is still mentally [[alert]] and does the crossword every day.
Staff have been told to remain [[alert]] to suspicious emails asking for passwords.

texts: A strong coffee keeps me [[alert]] during long afternoon meetings.
The guard dog was instantly [[alert]] when it heard footsteps.
Cyclists must stay [[alert]] to cars opening their doors.

badCollocation.noteRu: С alert используют предлог to: alert to the risks. Предлог of сюда по ошибке переносят из aware of.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Mentally alert — «с ясной головой, сообразительный». Careful, watchful и cautious описывают осторожное поведение, с mentally их не сочетают.

nuance.text: After three espressos, I felt wide awake and [[alert]].
nuance.explanationRu: Alert — «бодрый, собранный, всё замечающий». Careful — «осторожный, аккуратный» в действиях: кофе делает человека бодрым, а не осторожным.

reverse.text: Be [[careful]] with that pan — the handle is very hot.
reverse.explanationRu: Осторожно обращаться с чем-то — be careful with. Alert — про внимание и готовность заметить опасность, а не про аккуратность.

fixIt.text: After a sleepless night, I found it hard to stay [[careful]] during the afternoon meeting.
fixIt.explanationRu: Careful — «осторожный». Не клевать носом и сохранять ясную голову на встрече — stay alert.

wordFormation.text: Lack of sleep reduces your [[alertness]] more than you might think.

reply.context: Your flatmate says: "I've got a job interview at 8 a.m. tomorrow and I'm completely exhausted."
options: Great, being that tired will make you nice and alert for it.
Go to bed early, then. You'll want to be alert when they ask the tricky questions.
It is imperative that you maintain maximum alertness, my dear colleague.
reply.explanationRu: Alert — «собранный, с ясной головой», а усталость этому мешает, так что первый ответ нелогичен. Третий звучит как приказ начальника, а не совет соседу.

rewrite.original: Guards must watch carefully for anything unusual during the night shift.
rewrite.frame: Guards must stay ____ anything unusual during the night shift.
rewrite.explanationRu: Быть начеку, внимательно следить за чем-то — stay alert to.

words.definitionEn: strange, unfamiliar and not part of your normal experience or character
words.senseNote: Здесь — «чуждый, непривычный» (alien to someone), а не «инопланетный».
words.situation: Describing an idea, place or way of behaving that feels completely strange and unlike what you know.

examples.text: Having grown up in a tiny village, he found city life noisy, crowded and completely [[alien]].
Lying is so [[alien]] to her nature that she can't even keep a birthday surprise secret.
Many international students find British humour baffling and totally [[alien]] at first.

texts: Working from home felt [[alien]] to him after twenty years in an office.
Such rudeness is quite [[alien]] to the local culture.
Under the red sky, the desert landscape looked [[alien]] and hostile.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Чужой телефон» — someone else's phone. Alien значит «чуждый, непривычный», а не «принадлежащий другому».

collocationTask.prompt: Dishonesty was completely ___ to his nature.
collocationTask.explanationRu: Alien to someone's nature — «совершенно не свойственно». Odd, unknown и distant в сочетании to his nature в этом смысле не употребляют.

nuance.text: Such selfishness is [[alien]] to everything she believes in.
nuance.explanationRu: Alien to — «чуждо чему-то»: убеждениям, характеру, культуре. Strange в такой конструкции не работает: strange to everything she believes in звучит неестественно.

reverse.text: It's [[strange]] that nobody called to tell us about the delay.
reverse.explanationRu: «Странно, что» — it's strange that. Alien описывает что-то чуждое и непривычное, а не удивительный факт.

fixIt.text: The strict hierarchy at the bank felt completely [[alienated]] to me at first.
fixIt.explanationRu: Alienated описывает человека, который чувствует себя отчуждённым. Непривычные, чуждые правила — alien to me.

reply.context: A colleague who has just moved from Madrid to Oslo says: "People here eat dinner at five o'clock. Can you imagine?"
options: I can't! Eating that early would feel completely alien to me.
Wow, so Oslo must be full of alien people from Madrid now!
Indeed, such customs may be regarded as alien by persons of Iberian origin.
reply.explanationRu: Alien to me — «мне чуждо, непривычно». Во втором ответе alien ошибочно значит «приезжий», а третий звучит как научный отчёт, а не разговор с коллегой.

rewrite.original: Being late for meetings is completely unlike his character.
rewrite.frame: Being late for meetings is completely ____ his nature.
rewrite.explanationRu: Alien to someone's nature — «совершенно не свойственно кому-то».

words.definitionEn: to make people feel unfriendly towards you or stop supporting you
words.situation: When someone's words or decisions make friends, customers or voters turn away from them.

examples.text: The company [[alienated]] loyal customers by suddenly doubling the subscription price.
The party risks [[alienating]] older voters if it cuts pensions.
Her habit of correcting everyone's grammar [[alienates]] even her closest friends.

texts: Aggressive pop-up ads can [[alienate]] visitors to your website.
Try not to [[alienate]] your colleagues during your first week.
The director didn't want to [[alienate]] fans of the original book.

badCollocation.noteRu: Alienate — переходный глагол: alienate someone. «Отдалиться от родителей» — grow apart from или drift away from your parents.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Настроить людей против себя — alienate. Distance употребляют как distance yourself from, reject — «отвергать», remove — «убирать».

nuance.text: Years of broken promises had slowly [[alienated]] the town's residents.
nuance.explanationRu: Alienate — постепенно оттолкнуть людей, лишиться их доверия и поддержки. Offend — задеть, обидеть в конкретный момент; «медленно обидеть» звучит странно.

reverse.text: I hope I didn't [[offend]] you with that joke about your accent.
reverse.explanationRu: Задеть человека одной шуткой — offend. Alienate — оттолкнуть, отдалить от себя, обычно постепенно или целую группу людей.

fixIt.text: The new manager's rudeness quickly [[distanced]] most of the team.
fixIt.explanationRu: Distance обычно употребляют как distance yourself from. Оттолкнуть людей своим поведением — alienate them.

wordFormation.text: Many teenagers go through a period of [[alienation]] from their parents and teachers.

reply.context: Your manager asks: "Should we email our customers five special offers a week?"
options: I'd be careful. That many emails might alienate people rather than win them back.
Yes, five a week would alienate them in a good way: they'd feel really valued.
Such a frequency would inevitably precipitate the alienation of our esteemed clientele.
reply.explanationRu: Alienate — оттолкнуть, и «в хорошем смысле» оттолкнуть нельзя. Третий ответ звучит напыщенно и канцелярски для обычного обсуждения.

rewrite.original: The new rules made many long-time members turn against the club.
rewrite.frame: The new rules ____ many long-time members.
rewrite.explanationRu: Alienate someone — оттолкнуть, настроить против себя.

words.definitionEn: to adjust plans or ideas so that they match or support others
words.senseNote: Здесь — «приводить в соответствие, согласовывать», а не буквально «выравнивать в линию».
words.situation: Talking about making plans, goals or rules fit together or match something else, often at work.

examples.text: We need to [[align]] our marketing strategy with the company's new sustainability goals.
The new textbooks are [[aligned]] with the national curriculum, so teachers can use them immediately.
Before accepting the job, make sure the company's values [[align]] with your own.

texts: The central bank tried to [[align]] interest rates with those in neighbouring countries.
Couples need to [[align]] their expectations before planning a wedding.
Engineers must [[align]] the software update with the new hardware.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Согласовать встречу» — arrange или schedule a meeting. Align — приводить планы и цели в соответствие друг другу.

collocationTask.prompt: ___ your goals with the company's strategy
collocationTask.explanationRu: Привести цели в соответствие со стратегией — align them with it. Equal, level и straighten значат «равняться», «выравнивать поверхность», «выпрямлять».

nuance.text: Every project we fund must be [[aligned]] with our mission of reducing plastic waste.
nuance.explanationRu: Aligned with our mission — «соответствует миссии». Coordinate — организовать совместные действия людей или отделов; с миссией или ценностями его не сочетают.

reverse.text: A project manager [[coordinates]] the work of designers, writers and developers.
reverse.explanationRu: Организовать совместную работу людей — coordinate. Align — сверять цели и планы с чем-то, а не руководить работой.

fixIt.text: Our sales targets should be [[equalled]] with the company's long-term strategy.
fixIt.explanationRu: Equal — «равняться, сравняться» по величине. Привести цели в соответствие со стратегией — align them with it.

reply.context: Before a product launch, your boss asks the team: "Is there anything we still need to check?"
options: We should align the launch party with some balloons and loud music.
We should make sure the adverts align with our new brand guidelines.
Gotta align, like, all the stuff, innit?
reply.explanationRu: Align with — «соответствовать»: реклама должна соответствовать фирменному стилю. «Согласовать вечеринку с шарами» — бессмыслица, а третий ответ слишком небрежен для рабочей встречи.

rewrite.original: Our budget needs to match the goals we set for next year.
rewrite.frame: Our budget needs to ____ the goals we set for next year.
rewrite.explanationRu: Align with — «соответствовать, быть согласованным с».

words.definitionEn: a state in which plans, aims or groups agree with and support each other
words.senseNote: Здесь — «согласованность, соответствие» целей и позиций; техническое «выравнивание» (колёс, текста) не тренируем.
words.situation: Talking about whether a team's goals, a company's actions or people's views agree and support each other.

examples.text: There is little [[alignment]] between what the sales team promises and what the product can do.
The two parties are in close [[alignment]] on climate policy, which makes a coalition likely.
The inspectors praised the strong [[alignment]] between what is taught in class and what is tested in exams.

texts: Regular meetings keep the design and engineering teams in [[alignment]].
Voters expect some [[alignment]] between a candidate's promises and actions.
The new tax brings the country into [[alignment]] with its neighbours.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Выравнивание доходов» — income equalisation или narrowing the income gap. Alignment — согласованность целей и позиций, а не уравнивание.

collocationTask.explanationRu: In alignment with (как и in line with) — «в соответствии с». Correspondence — «переписка», equality — «равенство», similarity — «сходство»; в этом обороте они не работают.

nuance.text: There is a clear [[alignment]] between the company's prices and its premium image.
nuance.explanationRu: Alignment — соответствие, согласованность (цен и имиджа, целей и действий). Alliance — союз стран, партий или компаний; между ценой и имиджем союза быть не может.

reverse.text: The three charities have formed an [[alliance]] to share offices and staff.
reverse.explanationRu: Официальный союз организаций — an alliance (form an alliance). Alignment — не союз, а согласованность целей или позиций.

fixIt.text: There is little [[accordance]] between the brand's green image and its actual practices.
fixIt.explanationRu: Accordance живёт только в обороте in accordance with. Соответствие между имиджем и реальными делами — alignment.

wordFormation.text: The merger failed partly because of poor [[alignment]] between the two company cultures.

words.definitionEn: used after two groups to mean both of them equally
words.senseNote: Здесь — «и те и другие, в равной мере» (X and Y alike), а не просто «похожи» (they look alike).
words.situation: Saying that something affects or pleases two different groups equally, for example experts and beginners.

examples.text: The night market is popular with tourists and locals [[alike]].
Teachers and parents [[alike]] have complained that the new grading system is confusing.
Her debut novel won praise from critics and ordinary readers [[alike]].

texts: The exhibition fascinates children and adults [[alike]].
Rising rents affect students and young families [[alike]].
The new rules apply to managers and junior staff [[alike]].

badCollocation.noteRu: «Одинаково важный» — equally important. Alike ставят после двух групп людей (teachers and parents alike), а не перед прилагательным.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Young and old alike — «и молодые, и пожилые». Likewise и similarly не ставят после пары существительных, а same без the так не употребляют.

nuance.text: The storm damaged expensive villas and small cottages [[alike]].
nuance.explanationRu: Alike стоит сразу после двух групп: villas and cottages alike — «и те и другие». Likewise значит «так же, аналогично» и после пары существительных не ставится.

reverse.text: My sister became a doctor, and her husband did [[likewise]].
reverse.explanationRu: Did likewise — «поступил так же». Alike в этом значении с do не употребляют.

fixIt.text: This podcast is popular with scientists and ordinary listeners [[both]].
fixIt.explanationRu: После пары существительных «и те и другие» передают словом alike. Both ставят перед парой: both scientists and ordinary listeners.

reply.context: A friend asks: "Is the new science museum worth visiting if I don't have kids?"
options: Not really. The exhibits are alike for adults, so you'd get bored.
Indubitably; the establishment caters to juveniles and adults alike.
Definitely! It's designed for children and adults alike, and the space section is amazing.
reply.explanationRu: Alike после двух групп значит «и те и другие в равной мере». В первом ответе alike употреблено бессмысленно, а второй звучит напыщенно для разговора с другом.

words.definitionEn: a claim that someone has done something wrong, made without proof
words.situation: Reporting that someone has been publicly accused of wrongdoing, although nothing has been proved yet.

examples.text: The singer has denied [[allegations]] that she copied the melody from an unknown band.
The university is investigating an [[allegation]] of bullying made by a junior researcher.
Several patients have made [[allegations]] of negligence against the clinic's chief surgeon.

texts: The minister has strongly denied the [[allegations]] against her.
Journalists must check [[allegations]] carefully before publishing them.
The company says the [[allegations]] of pollution are unfounded.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Обвинение в мошенничестве» — an allegation of fraud. Предлог in здесь — калька с русского.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Отрицать обвинения — deny the allegations (или reject them). Refuse и decline — «отказываться» от предложения, negate — «сводить на нет».

nuance.text: The newspaper published [[allegations]] that the mayor had accepted gifts from builders.
nuance.explanationRu: Allegation — обвинение, которое кто-то высказывает публично, без доказательств, например в газете. Charge — официальное обвинение полиции или прокурора; газеты его не выдвигают.

reverse.text: He pleaded not guilty to both [[charges]] at the first hearing.
reverse.explanationRu: В суде признают или не признают вину по официальным обвинениям — charges. Allegations — обвинения в прессе или жалобах, до суда.

fixIt.text: The director denied all the [[blames]] made against him in the press.
fixIt.explanationRu: Blame — неисчисляемое «вина», во множественном числе не употребляется. Публичные обвинения в прессе — allegations.

wordFormation.text: She made a serious [[allegation]] against her former employer.

reply.context: A colleague whispers: "Someone says the finance director has been taking money from the company."
options: It's only an allegation so far. Let's not judge him until there's an investigation.
Then it's an allegation, which means he's definitely guilty.
Such allegations must be substantiated forthwith by the relevant parties, dear colleague.
reply.explanationRu: Allegation — обвинение без доказательств, поэтому оно не доказывает вину. Третий ответ звучит как официальный документ, а не реплика в разговоре.

words.definitionEn: to state that someone did something wrong without giving proof
words.situation: Reporting a serious claim about wrongdoing, especially in news or court, before anyone has proved it.

examples.text: The lawsuit [[alleges]] that the landlord ignored repeated complaints about damp.
Two former employees have [[alleged]] that they were paid less than male colleagues and are suing the firm.
The player is [[alleged]] to have accepted money to lose the match.

texts: The report [[alleged]] that safety checks had been skipped.
Critics have [[alleged]] that the contest was fixed.
She [[alleged]] that her neighbour had damaged her car.

badCollocation.noteRu: Allege не строится как accuse: нельзя allege someone of something. Говорят allege that he committed fraud или accuse him of fraud.

collocationTask.prompt: It is ___ that the director hid the losses.
collocationTask.explanationRu: Безличное «утверждается, что» — it is alleged that. С accuse и blame нужен человек (accuse someone of), а complain так не употребляют.

nuance.text: The article [[alleges]] that the factory has been dumping waste into the river.
nuance.explanationRu: Allege сочетается с that: alleges that the factory has been dumping waste. Accuse требует дополнения и предлога of: accuses the factory of dumping waste.

reverse.text: My neighbour [[accused]] me of stealing her parking space.
reverse.explanationRu: Обвинить кого-то в чём-то — accuse someone of something. Allege так не строится: alleged me of — ошибка.

fixIt.text: The newspaper [[pretends]] that the minister knew about the problem months ago.
fixIt.explanationRu: Pretend — «притворяться». Если газета утверждает что-то без доказательств, нужно alleges that.

rewrite.original: People say, without any proof, that the manager lied to investors.
rewrite.frame: The manager ____ lied to investors.
rewrite.explanationRu: Be alleged to have done — «по утверждениям, сделал (но это не доказано)».

words.definitionEn: according to what people claim, although it has not been proved
words.situation: Reporting what someone is said to have done, while making clear it has not been proved.

examples.text: Nothing has been proved yet, but the director [[allegedly]] hid the losses from investors.
My neighbour's cat [[allegedly]] ate a whole chicken, but nobody actually saw it happen.
The painting was [[allegedly]] stolen from a castle during the war, though no records survive.

texts: The documents were [[allegedly]] leaked by a junior employee.
The restaurant [[allegedly]] reused bread from customers' plates.
He [[allegedly]] lied about his age to join the army.

badCollocation.noteRu: Перед существительным нужно прилагательное: the alleged thief. Allegedly — наречие: he allegedly stole the money.

collocationTask.prompt: The money was ___ stolen by a former employee.
collocationTask.explanationRu: Allegedly — «якобы, по чьим-то словам». Admittedly — «надо признать», accordingly — «соответственно», arguably — «пожалуй, можно утверждать».

nuance.text: The two officials [[allegedly]] accepted bribes, and their trial begins next month.
nuance.explanationRu: Allegedly — осторожное слово юристов и журналистов о предполагаемых преступлениях до суда. Apparently — разговорное «похоже, говорят»; в новости о суде оно звучит небрежно.

reverse.text: [[Apparently]], the new café on the corner does amazing pancakes.
reverse.explanationRu: Пересказать приятный слух — apparently («говорят»). Allegedly намекает на недоказанное обвинение и про блинчики звучит странно.

fixIt.text: The accountant [[as if]] moved the money to a secret account.
fixIt.explanationRu: «Якобы» не переводится как as if: as if — «как будто» в сравнениях. О недоказанных обвинениях говорят allegedly.

wordFormation.text: The actor was [[allegedly]] paid twice for the same advertisement.

reply.context: Your friend texts: "Is it true that the new gym manager was fired for stealing?"
options: Yes, he allegedly stole it. I watched him take the cash on camera myself.
Nobody knows for sure. He allegedly took money from the till, but nothing's been proved.
It is alleged, by persons unknown, that the gentleman misappropriated funds.
reply.explanationRu: Allegedly — «якобы, по чьим-то словам, но не доказано». Если вы сами всё видели, allegedly не нужно. Третий ответ звучит как протокол, а не сообщение другу.

rewrite.original: According to some people, the mayor used public money for his holiday, but this hasn't been proved.
rewrite.frame: The mayor ____ used public money for his holiday.
rewrite.explanationRu: Allegedly — «якобы»: о том, что утверждают, но не доказали.

words.definitionEn: to make pain, suffering or a problem less severe
words.situation: Talking about making pain, stress, poverty or another problem less serious, though not removing it completely.

examples.text: Gentle stretching can [[alleviate]] back pain caused by sitting at a desk all day.
The new bridge was built to [[alleviate]] traffic congestion in the city centre.
Flexible hours have helped [[alleviate]] stress among staff with young children.

texts: This cream should [[alleviate]] the itching within minutes.
Extra funding could [[alleviate]] the shortage of teachers.
Nothing she said could [[alleviate]] his fears about the operation.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Облегчить задачу» — make the task easier или simplify it. Alleviate смягчает боль, страдания и проблемы, а не задания.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Облегчить симптомы — alleviate (или relieve) the symptoms. Lighten — «делать легче по весу или светлее», soften — «смягчать» материал или тон, facilitate — «содействовать».

nuance.text: Regular breaks can [[alleviate]] eye strain for people who work at screens.
nuance.explanationRu: Оба слова переводят как «облегчать», но alleviate — ослаблять боль или проблему, а facilitate — делать процесс проще. Facilitate eye strain означало бы «способствовать» усталости глаз.

reverse.text: The new software will [[facilitate]] communication between the two offices.
reverse.explanationRu: Облегчить, упростить процесс — facilitate. Alleviate ослабляет что-то плохое, а общение — не проблема.

fixIt.text: The doctor gave her some tablets to [[lighten]] the pain in her knee.
fixIt.explanationRu: Lighten — «делать легче по весу или светлее». Облегчить боль — alleviate the pain.

wordFormation.text: The charity focuses on the [[alleviation]] of hunger in rural areas.

reply.context: A colleague says: "I've had a terrible headache all morning, and my presentation is at three."
options: Oh no! Staring at your screen all day will alleviate it even more.
Kindly procure an analgesic to alleviate the aforementioned discomfort.
Try drinking some water and getting some fresh air. That might alleviate it a bit.
reply.explanationRu: Alleviate — ослабить боль, а не усилить её, так что первый ответ нелогичен. Второй звучит как инструкция к лекарству, а не совет коллеге.

rewrite.original: Talking to a counsellor has made her anxiety less severe.
rewrite.frame: Talking to a counsellor has ____ her anxiety.
rewrite.explanationRu: Alleviate — сделать боль, тревогу или проблему слабее.

words.definitionEn: an agreement between countries, groups or companies to work together
words.situation: Talking about countries, parties or companies that agree to cooperate because they share goals or enemies.

examples.text: The two airlines formed an [[alliance]] so that passengers could book connecting flights more easily.
In an unlikely [[alliance]], farmers and environmental groups campaigned together against the new motorway.
In the reality show, contestants form secret [[alliances]] to avoid being voted off.

texts: The small party refused to enter an [[alliance]] with its old rivals.
Several hospitals have formed an [[alliance]] to share expensive equipment.
The two kingdoms sealed their [[alliance]] with a royal marriage.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Профсоюз» — a trade union. Alliance — союз стран, партий или компаний, а не организация работников.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Заключить союз — form (или forge) an alliance. Do, take и open с alliance не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The three countries remain independent but have formed a defensive [[alliance]].
nuance.explanationRu: Alliance — союз самостоятельных сторон ради общей цели. Union — объединение в единое целое (the European Union, a trade union), и с remain independent оно спорит.

reverse.text: She is an active member of the teachers' [[union]].
reverse.explanationRu: Профсоюз — union (the teachers' union, a trade union). Слово alliance для профсоюзов не используют.

fixIt.text: The two companies have entered into a strategic [[union]] to develop electric vans.
fixIt.explanationRu: Союз компаний ради общей цели — a strategic alliance. Union — полное слияние в одно целое или профсоюз.

wordFormation.text: The small shops on our street have formed an [[alliance]] to compete with the supermarket.

words.definitionEn: to officially give money, time or resources for a particular purpose
words.situation: Deciding officially how much money, time, space or staff will go to each project, person or purpose.

examples.text: The council has [[allocated]] an extra two million pounds to school repairs.
On their first day, new employees are [[allocated]] a desk, a laptop and a locker by the office manager.
During exams, try to [[allocate]] your time according to how many marks each question is worth.

texts: Each student is [[allocated]] a personal tutor in the first week.
Funds were [[allocated]] to rebuild the damaged bridge.
We were [[allocated]] a table right next to the kitchen door.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Выделить главную мысль» — highlight или identify the main idea. Allocate — выделять деньги, время или ресурсы.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Выделить деньги — allocate funds. Select («отобрать»), distinguish («отличить») и extract («извлечь») тоже бывают «выделить», но к деньгам не подходят.

nuance.text: The school has [[allocated]] five thousand pounds for new books but has not bought any yet.
nuance.explanationRu: Allocate — выделить, зарезервировать деньги на цель. Spend — реально потратить; «потратили, но ничего не купили» — противоречие.

reverse.text: We [[spent]] far too much on the taxi from the airport.
reverse.explanationRu: Потратить деньги на что-то — spend on. Allocate — заранее выделить средства по плану; о тратах на такси так не говорят.

fixIt.text: The government will [[highlight]] extra money for rural hospitals next year.
fixIt.explanationRu: Highlight — «выделять, подчёркивать» в тексте или речи. Выделить деньги — allocate money.

reply.context: Your boss asks: "How are you planning to prepare for next month's conference?"
options: I've allocated two full days next week just for writing the slides.
I've allocated the slides, so they're completely finished now.
Gonna allocate some time or whatever, dunno yet.
reply.explanationRu: Allocate time for something — выделить время на задачу. Allocate не значит «закончить», а третий ответ слишком небрежен для разговора с начальником.

words.definitionEn: an amount of money, space or time officially given for a purpose
words.situation: Talking about how money, seats, tickets or time are officially shared out, or the share each person gets.

examples.text: The [[allocation]] of funds between schools has been criticised as unfair to rural areas.
Each club receives a ticket [[allocation]] of about three thousand seats for away matches.
Staff complained that the [[allocation]] of parking spaces favoured senior managers.

texts: The hospital's budget [[allocation]] was cut by ten per cent.
Seat [[allocation]] for the exam is done by surname.
Each country's fishing [[allocation]] is agreed every December.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Выделение тепла» — the release of heat. Allocation — распределение денег, мест или времени, а не физический процесс.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Справедливое распределение ресурсов — a fair allocation of resources. Location — «местоположение», separation — «разделение», isolation — «изоляция».

nuance.text: The government announced a larger [[allocation]] of funds for flood defences.
nuance.explanationRu: Allocation — распределение бюджета между целями и проектами. Allowance — положенная человеку сумма или норма (baggage allowance, travel allowance); к бюджету на защиту от наводнений не подходит.

reverse.text: Business-class tickets come with a bigger baggage [[allowance]].
reverse.explanationRu: Норма багажа пассажира — baggage allowance. Allocation — распределение ресурсов, а не личная норма.

fixIt.text: The [[selection]] of funds for the new stadium was approved by the city council.
fixIt.explanationRu: Selection — «выбор, отбор». Выделение денег на проект — allocation of funds.

wordFormation.text: Teachers are unhappy about the [[allocation]] of classrooms for next term.

words.definitionEn: an amount of money or something else that you are officially permitted
words.senseNote: Здесь — «положенная норма или выплата» (baggage allowance, travel allowance), а не карманные деньги ребёнка.
words.situation: Talking about the fixed amount of money, luggage, data or holiday you are officially entitled to.

examples.text: My suitcase was three kilos over the baggage [[allowance]], so I had to pay extra.
Employees who travel for work receive a daily [[allowance]] for meals and taxis.
I used up my entire mobile data [[allowance]] watching films on the train.

texts: Students can apply for a housing [[allowance]] if they live away from home.
The recommended daily [[allowance]] of salt is about six grams.
Check the luggage [[allowance]] before you book a budget flight.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Разрешение уйти пораньше» — permission to leave early. Allowance — положенная сумма или норма, а не разрешение.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Норма провоза багажа — baggage allowance. Norm — «норма поведения», permission — «разрешение», standard — «стандарт качества».

nuance.text: On top of her salary, she gets a monthly [[allowance]] for childcare.
nuance.explanationRu: Allowance — дополнительная выплата на конкретные расходы: жильё, питание, детский сад. Wage — оплата за сам труд, и зарплату «на детский сад» не выдают.

reverse.text: Cleaners at the hotel earn the minimum [[wage]].
reverse.explanationRu: Минимальная оплата труда — the minimum wage. Allowance — не зарплата, а положенная доплата или норма.

fixIt.text: Economy passengers have a hand luggage [[norm]] of seven kilos.
fixIt.explanationRu: Norm — «норма поведения» или «стандарт». Разрешённый вес ручной клади — hand luggage allowance.

wordFormation.text: The company pays each employee a generous travel [[allowance]] for conferences abroad.

reply.context: Your friend is packing: "Can I take this huge suitcase on the plane for free?"
options: Sure, the allowance means you can take as much luggage as you like.
Check your ticket first. Budget airlines often include only a small cabin bag in the allowance.
Pursuant to the carrier's regulations, one's allowance is strictly delimited.
reply.explanationRu: Allowance — это ограниченная норма, а не «сколько угодно». Третий ответ звучит как юридический документ, а не совет другу.

rewrite.original: Passengers on this flight may bring up to twenty kilos of luggage free of charge.
rewrite.frame: The luggage ____ on this flight is twenty kilos.
rewrite.explanationRu: Норма провоза багажа — luggage allowance.

words.definitionEn: a person, group or country that supports you when others oppose you
words.situation: Talking about someone who is on your side and helps you in an argument, competition or conflict.

examples.text: When the board wanted to close our department, the finance director became our strongest [[ally]] and argued to keep it open.
The two countries have been close [[allies]] since the end of the Second World War.
Parents of teenagers should see teachers as [[allies]], not enemies.

texts: She found an unexpected [[ally]] in her former boss.
Regular exercise is your best [[ally]] against stress.
The senator lost her closest [[ally]] when he retired.

badCollocation.noteRu: Школьный друг — a school friend. Ally — союзник в борьбе или споре, а не просто приятель.

collocationTask.prompt: a close ___ of the prime minister
collocationTask.explanationRu: Соратник политика, который его поддерживает, — a close ally. Alliance и union — союзы, а не люди, а partisan — «партизан» или «ярый сторонник партии».

nuance.text: Over the years, the two leaders became close personal [[allies]].
nuance.explanationRu: Ally — союзник, то есть сторона: человек или страна. Alliance — сам союз, соглашение о сотрудничестве; человек не может быть alliance.

reverse.text: The treaty created a military [[alliance]] between four states.
reverse.explanationRu: Договор создаёт союз — an alliance. Ally — участник союза, а не сам союз.

fixIt.text: In the fight to save the local library, the mayor proved a useful [[companion]].
fixIt.explanationRu: Companion — спутник, компаньон в поездке или в жизни. Тот, кто помогает в борьбе за общую цель, — an ally.

reply.context: Your colleague says: "I want to propose a four-day week at the meeting, but I'm scared nobody will back me."
options: Don't worry, I'll be your ally and vote against it with everyone else.
One must endeavour to secure allies prior to submitting such a proposal.
Talk to Sam from HR first. She's been pushing for flexible hours, so she'd be a natural ally.
reply.explanationRu: Ally — тот, кто на вашей стороне, а не голосует против. Второй ответ звучит как учебник по дипломатии, а не дружеский совет.

words.definitionEn: a light, silver-coloured metal used for cans, foil and aircraft parts
words.situation: Talking about a light metal used for drink cans, kitchen foil, window frames or parts of planes.

examples.text: Drinks cans made of [[aluminium]] can be recycled again and again without losing quality.
Car makers are switching from steel to [[aluminium]] to make vehicles lighter.
We replaced the old wooden window frames with [[aluminium]] ones that never need painting.

texts: Wrap the fish in [[aluminium]] foil before putting it on the barbecue.
The bike's light [[aluminium]] frame makes it easy to carry upstairs.
Recycling [[aluminium]] uses far less energy than producing it from ore.

badCollocation.noteRu: Тонкая кухонная фольга — aluminium foil (разговорно tin foil). Aluminium paper по-английски не говорят.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Кухонная фольга — aluminium foil (разговорно tin foil). Из железа, меди и стали фольгу для еды не делают.

nuance.text: Most drinks cans today are made of [[aluminium]], which is light and easy to recycle.
nuance.explanationRu: Банки для напитков делают из алюминия — aluminium. Tin — олово; в британском английском a tin — ещё и консервная банка, но она из жести, а не из олова.

reverse.text: Open a [[tin]] of tomatoes and add it to the sauce.
reverse.explanationRu: Консервная банка в британском английском — a tin (в американском — a can). Aluminium — металл, а не упаковка.

fixIt.text: Most modern planes are built mainly from [[tin]] and other light metals.
fixIt.explanationRu: Tin — олово, для самолётов оно не годится. Лёгкий металл для корпусов самолётов — aluminium.

words.definitionEn: doing an activity for pleasure rather than as a paid job
words.senseNote: Здесь — «любительский, не за деньги»; неодобрительное «дилетантский» чаще передают словом amateurish.
words.situation: Describing people who paint, act, play sport or take photos for fun, not to earn money.

examples.text: The play was performed by an [[amateur]] theatre group, but the acting was surprisingly good.
He played [[amateur]] football for years before a professional club finally signed him.
Two [[amateur]] astronomers, a teacher and a retired plumber, spotted the comet before any observatory did.

texts: My uncle is a keen [[amateur]] photographer who enters every local competition.
The race is open to [[amateur]] cyclists of all ages.
She sings with an [[amateur]] choir that meets every Tuesday evening.

badCollocation.noteRu: «Любитель джаза» — a jazz fan или a jazz lover. Amateur — тот, кто сам занимается делом непрофессионально, а не поклонник.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Amateur dramatics — любительский театр, «самодеятельность». Hobby, private и fan с dramatics не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The club is proud of its [[amateur]] status: nobody, not even the coach, gets paid.
nuance.explanationRu: Amateur — нейтральное «любительский, не за деньги». Amateurish — «дилетантский, неумелый», это критика; к статусу клуба без зарплат не подходит.

fixIt.text: My father is a keen [[amateurish]] photographer who spends every weekend in the hills.
fixIt.explanationRu: Amateurish — «дилетантский, неумелый», это критика. Фотограф-любитель — an amateur photographer.

wordFormation.text: The logo looks rather [[amateurish]], as if someone drew it in five minutes.

reply.context: At a dinner party, someone asks you: "So, are you a professional musician?"
options: No, I'm an amateur of classical music: I listen to it every day.
Negative; my musical engagements are strictly of an amateur nature, madam.
No, I just play the cello in an amateur orchestra at weekends, for fun.
reply.explanationRu: Amateur orchestra — любительский оркестр, где играют не за деньги. «Любитель музыки» — music lover, а не amateur of music. Второй ответ слишком чопорный для ужина.

rewrite.original: She plays golf for fun and doesn't get paid for it.
rewrite.frame: She is ____ golfer.
rewrite.explanationRu: An amateur golfer — игрок-любитель, который не получает денег за игру.

words.definitionEn: a well-known person who represents and promotes a company, cause or activity
words.senseNote: Здесь — «представитель, лицо» бренда или идеи (brand ambassador); основное значение «посол страны» считаем уже известным.
words.situation: Talking about a famous or respected person chosen to promote a brand, charity, sport or good cause.

examples.text: The sportswear company hired a young tennis star as its new brand [[ambassador]].
The actress became a goodwill [[ambassador]] for a children's charity and visited refugee camps in three countries.
Our university trains older students as [[ambassadors]] who show new students around the campus.

texts: The former champion is now an [[ambassador]] for women's football.
Every satisfied customer becomes an [[ambassador]] for your brand.
The famous chef acts as an [[ambassador]] for healthy school meals.

badCollocation.noteRu: Посол в стране — ambassador to France, а представитель бренда или идеи — ambassador for the brand или brand ambassador.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Знаменитость, которая представляет бренд, — brand ambassador. Consul, messenger и deputy с brand не сочетаются.

nuance.text: The bank pays the tennis player to act as its [[ambassador]] at tournaments.
nuance.explanationRu: Ambassador — человек, который представляет компанию и продвигает её имидж. Sponsor — тот, кто даёт деньги; здесь спонсор — сам банк, а не теннисист.

reverse.text: A local bakery is the main [[sponsor]] of our school's charity run.
reverse.explanationRu: Кто финансирует мероприятие — sponsor. Ambassador представляет и продвигает его, а не платит.

fixIt.text: The famous skier works as an [[embassy]] for a ski-equipment brand.
fixIt.explanationRu: Embassy — посольство, учреждение. Человек, который представляет бренд, — ambassador.

words.definitionEn: to make small changes to a law, document or plan to improve it
words.situation: Changing the wording of a law, contract, report or plan, usually to correct or improve it.

examples.text: Parliament voted to [[amend]] the law so that it also covers online shopping.
We [[amended]] the contract to give freelancers thirty days to submit their invoices.
Please [[amend]] the spelling of my surname on the certificate before it is printed.

texts: The rules were [[amended]] to allow dogs in the park.
She [[amended]] her statement after seeing the video evidence.
The recipe has been [[amended]] to use less sugar.

badCollocation.noteRu: Технику чинят — repair или fix the washing machine. Amend — вносить правки в текст, закон или план.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Поправки в конституцию или закон вносят глаголом amend. Repair — «чинить», correct — «исправлять ошибку», edit — «редактировать текст».

nuance.text: The government plans to [[amend]] the tax code to support small farms.
nuance.explanationRu: Amend — официально изменить закон или документ, чтобы улучшить его. Correct — исправить ошибку, а налоговый кодекс здесь не ошибочен: его дополняют.

reverse.text: The teacher [[corrected]] the spelling mistakes in red ink.
reverse.explanationRu: Исправить ошибки — correct mistakes. Amend меняет документ или закон, а не отдельные ошибки учеников.

fixIt.text: The club decided to [[repair]] its rules so that members can vote online.
fixIt.explanationRu: Repair — «чинить» вещи. Внести изменения в правила — amend the rules.

reply.context: A customer emails: "Sorry, I put the wrong delivery address on my order yesterday."
options: No problem, I've amended your parcel, so it's now much heavier.
No problem at all. I've amended the address, so the parcel will go to the right place.
Yeah whatever, sorted it, chill.
reply.explanationRu: Amend — исправить или изменить данные, например адрес в заказе. Посылку «исправить» так нельзя, а третий ответ слишком грубый для письма клиенту.

rewrite.original: The government changed the law slightly last year.
rewrite.frame: The law ____ last year.
rewrite.explanationRu: Нужен пассив: the law was amended.

words.definitionEn: a change or addition to a law, contract or official document
words.situation: Talking about an official change added to a law, constitution or contract after a vote or agreement.

examples.text: The opposition proposed an [[amendment]] that would protect small shops from the new tax.
Any [[amendments]] to this contract must be agreed in writing by both parties.
The editor accepted the article after I made a few minor [[amendments]] to the conclusion.

texts: The [[amendment]] was passed by a narrow majority.
Freedom of speech is protected by the First [[Amendment]] in the United States.
The tenant asked for an [[amendment]] allowing her to keep a cat.

badCollocation.noteRu: Поправка к закону — an amendment to the law, а не for the law.

collocationTask.explanationRu: Поправка к конституции — a constitutional amendment. Correction — исправление ошибки, repair — ремонт, patch — «заплатка»; с constitutional так не говорят.

nuance.text: The council voted to add an [[amendment]] banning cars from the old town.
